description: This Java source file defines the 'PolicyEntriesRoute' class, which constructs HTTP routes for handling policy entries in an Akka HTTP server. It includes route definitions for CRUD operations on policies, subjects, and resources, within the context of a gateway service, utilizing various imported models, commands, and utilities.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesRoute
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractRoute, responsible for constructing Akka HTTP routes for managing policy entries, including CRUD operations for policies, subjects, and resources within the '/entries' path.

methods.name: buildPolicyEntriesRoute
methods.description: Constructs the route for '/entries' endpoint, composing sub-routes for various policy operations.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntries
methods.description: Defines GET and PUT handlers for the '/entries' path, managing multiple policy entries.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntry
methods.description: Defines GET, PUT, and DELETE handlers for a specific policy entry identified by a label.

methods.name: createPolicyEntryForPut
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry object from a JSON string and label during PUT requests.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntrySubjects
methods.description: Defines GET and PUT handlers for subjects under a specific policy entry.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntrySubjectsEntry
methods.description: Defines GET, PUT, and DELETE handlers for individual subjects within a policy entry.

methods.name: createSubjectForPut
methods.description: Creates a Subject object from a JSON string and subjectId during PUT requests.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntryResources
methods.description: Defines GET and PUT handlers for resources under a specific policy entry.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntryResourcesEntry
methods.description: Defines GET, PUT, and DELETE handlers for individual resources within a policy entry.

methods.name: createResourceForPut
methods.description: Creates a Resource object from a JSON string and resource key during PUT requests.

methods.name: resourceKeyFromUnmatchedPath
methods.description: Extracts ResourceKey from unmatched path string, removing leading slash if present.
